title: The Hare and the Tortoise
description: A speedy hare is certain he cannot lose, until a quiet tortoise shows what steady determination can do.
catalogueBlurb: A boastful hare learns that steady determination can win the race.
author: Aesop, told anew by Joseph Jacobs

cover.alt: Richard Heighway's 1894 illustration for The Hare and the Tortoise.

illustrations.caption: Illustration by Richard Heighway, 1894.

illustrations.alt: Richard Heighway's 1894 line illustration of the tortoise reaching the finish.
illustrations.caption: Illustration by Richard Heighway, 1894.

text.source: Joseph Jacobs, The Fables of Aesop, Macmillan, 1894
text.notes: The underlying Aesop fable and Joseph Jacobs' 1894 retelling are public domain. Jacobs died in 1916.

illustrations.notes: Source files are marked public domain on Wikimedia Commons. Heighway died in 1917.
